description: Automated adversarial AI safety testing, compliance certification, and multi-tenant sandboxed validation platform for Large Language Models.

runtime_modes.description: Runs mock Auth (8004), Benchmark (8006), Session (8000), and WebSocket (8011) in a single Python process with zero external dependencies.
Spawns all 8 production FastAPI microservices concurrently via local subprocess with auto-generated Fernet keys and MOCK_LLM=1.
Full containerized mesh including Kafka, Zookeeper, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Nginx gateway, and 8 microservices.

services.name: auth-service
services.purpose: User registration, JWT login, and Fernet-encrypted LLM provider API key storage.

services.name: session-manager
services.database: In-memory session keys + Kafka audit emitter
services.purpose: Central cryptographic bus broker, dynamic per-session Fernet key generation, and timing destruction micro-batching.

services.name: llm-proxy
services.purpose: Sandboxed inference engine with prompt echo filtering, semantic cosine leak detection, and GPU VRAM purging.

services.name: red-team
services.purpose: Adversarial attack generation engine (Direct, Jailbreak, Roleplay, PAIR, GCG suffix).

services.name: blue-team
services.purpose: Defense evaluation classifier using LoRA fine-tuned Toxic-BERT to compute bypass rates.

services.name: benchmark-service
services.purpose: Drill orchestration, progress polling, historical runs, and leaderboard aggregation.

services.name: audit-service
services.purpose: Tamper-evident append-only SHA-256 Merkle chain ledger and public /verify endpoint.

services.name: audit-gateway
services.purpose: WebSocket telemetry gateway streaming live attack classifications, progress, and drill completion to the frontend.

frontend_routes.purpose: Resilience scores, compliance badges, and certificate view

top_defects.description: TypeScript compiler error TS2554: useRef expects 1 argument.
Socket binding error string prepended to file docstring.
Stale test file paths causing make test to fail.
Dynamic session key transmitted in plaintext Kafka header.
KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS set to localhost breaks container routing.
Audit head hash advances non-atomically outside DB transaction.
ast.literal_eval used for batch deserialization instead of JSON.
Missing Kubernetes deployment manifests for auth-service, audit-gateway, and mongodb.
Safety datasets contain only 3 hardcoded prompts.
